findings.location: source.html — first paragraph and subsequent scripture-quotation paragraphs
findings.source_quote: “Blessed are the pure in heart” (Matthew 5:8). “That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere (pure) and without offense till the day of Christ” (Philippians 1:10). “Think on things that are pure” (Philippians 4:8). “Keep thyself pure” (1Timothy 5:22). Revelation 19 says “The pure in heart shall see God.” Psalm 24:3-4 asks “Who shall see God?” The answer is “he that hath clean hands and a pure heart.”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate or render these quoted Scripture lines into Bengali so they convey the printed English wording of the authoritative article, preserving the verse references and any parenthetical clarifications. For example, replace the English quotes with Bengali renderings that faithfully convey the printed English text, while keeping the parenthetical verse citations intact and in the same position inside the paragraph. Preserve all existing HTML tags and attributes exactly. (Do not replace with a different Bible version; the Bengali text should reflect the English sentences presented in the source.)

findings.source_quote: John 10:10, James 1:15: “Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death” Verse 16 says, “Do not (be deceived) my beloved brethren.” Hebrews 4:13 says, “Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom (we will give account to).” Numbers 32:23 is still very true, saying, “Be sure your sin will find you out.”
